scientific_question: Is there sufficient independently surveyed island and coastal continental rock support to attempt a detection-aware, site-level Antarctic seabird association distinct from prior published search-effort maps?

published_results_prior_art.paper: Southwell et al. 2025 Diversity and Distributions 31:e70066

rules.unit_for_spatial_source_support: original unique geog_site_id x species_code x season
rules.strict_A: only direct original A with no co-occurring P or NR for the same site/species/season
rules.strict_P: direct original P with no contradictory A for the same site/species/season
rules.certainty: preserve source occurrence_cert_cat and expert validation; do not infer from row count
rules.geographic_class: read geog_site_feature and subgroup exactly as original, do not infer mainland from SCAR FID
rules.mainland_controls: flying seabirds only and independently verify exposure of coastal vs inland habitat; flightless Adélie cannot access continental inland 1km+
rules.independence: unique physical landmass and independent source, not 33k event rows or old atlas duplicate sites
rules.longitudinal: only consecutive actually observed A/P seasons; do not bridge missing or NR
rules.unsurveyed: 7785 potential sites include many unvisited; no source row is not absence

preserve_prior_stops: Paper2 original 2km area by habitat p=0.0947 nonconfirmatory
AADC original ADP-only PR180 consecutive A-to-P n=1 STOP
MAPPPD original strict SCAR land continuity V41 STOP
ASI peninsula proxy exploratory OR 0.745 CI crossing 1
next_executable_check: Source-pinned read of two current survey workbooks, join 7785 geog sites with 216 certainty tuples, count actual P/A/NR by species, site and original feature; DO NOT fit outcomes or claim new substrate exposure.
limitations: Not an independent new penguin sample; ADP original 11089 rows previously audited.
The 2025 East Antarctic domain and 2016 original candidate atlas do not overlap Western Antarctic Peninsula 25 GLIMS rock candidates.
No post-2024 field observation on newly exposed rock and no measured mammalian predator exposure.
Published Southwell et al 2025 already analyzes source detection, accessibility and ignorance; unadjusted duplicate plots are not novel.
Source schema count discrepancy 190 must be resolved before equating records with published article.
